entities.name: William Pinkney Whyte

entities.summary: William Pinkney Whyte was a member of the United States Democratic Party from Maryland, who served as a state delegate, the state comptroller, a United States senator, the 35th governor, the mayor of Baltimore, and the state attorney general.
